fields.description:
When no Container Price matches the requested collection configuration:
  • Factorize: silently scales the default rate proportionally based on the collection configuration ratio.
  • Warn: tries an exact match first, then factorizes from the default if not found, and notifies the user in either case.
  • Stop: blocks the transaction until a matching Container Price is explicitly created.
fields.label: Missing Container Price Action

fields.description: Controls which scoping dimension takes precedence when resolving Service Pricing Rules. Set each dimension's Priority rank (1 = highest authority): rank 1 → weight 4, rank 2 → weight 2, rank 3 → weight 1. These power-of-two weights guarantee that every combination of dimensions produces a unique score — eliminating ties without manual configuration. List all three scope types, each with a distinct priority (1, 2, 3).
fields.label: Pricing Rule Priority
